_comment: Cuff checklist strings (Plan/15). English only. Limit names and the dose-where text are read from eva.en.json (read-only).

screen.title: Marswalk · Cuff checklist (print)
screen.intro: Printable cards for a walking EVA in Gale Crater (simulation). Values are computed by the same code as EVA mode.
screen.size_note: Card size 90 × 60 mm and 8 cards per A4 page are assumptions; the size of a real cuff checklist was not verified.
screen.print_hint: In the print dialog choose A4, scale 100%, and turn off headers and footers. Cards are black on white; warnings use borders and symbols, not colour.
screen.count: {n} cards · {p} A4 page(s) at 8 cards per page
screen.error: Failed to load: {msg}. Serve the site folder with "python3 -m http.server".

summary.title: SUMMARY
summary.no_go: DO NOT START: limits leave no time to walk out
summary.over: Plan is over the limit (auto turnaround off)
summary.dose_spike: Dose: sol 4716 replay (transient event, cause unconfirmed)
summary.compass: No global magnetic field on Mars: a magnetic compass does not work. Bearings are from map north. Use another reference.

stop.beyond: PAST TURN POINT: do not go beyond the turn point

limits.title: LIMITS†
limits.note: Limits are assumptions; the dose budget is a planning budget, not a health limit. ► binding. ■ past the turn point.

contingency.title: IF…†
contingency.steep: Slope 25° or more ahead: stop. Do not cross. Check the route.
contingency.los: Line of sight lost: stop. Go back to the last point with line of sight.
contingency.assumed: General rules assumed for this demonstration. Not flight procedures.
contingency.disc: SIMULATION, not flight software. Limits are assumptions. Dose = RAD mean on the rover deck {where}, not a forecast, not in-suit. Ground temperature = REMS hourly mean, not suit temperature. Slope: 5 m grid. Line of sight: no relays.
